snippet.title: Infinite Rails - Game announcement
snippet.description:
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399920/Infinite_Rails/?beta=0
EPIC GAMES: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/infinite-rails-f099aa

🌟 Infinite Rails – Build the railway empire of your dreams! 🌟

Step into a procedurally generated endless world where your creativity knows no bounds. Lay tracks, connect unique stations, and transport passengers and resources across your ever-expanding network. Complete dynamic tasks to unlock powerful new locomotives fueled by a variety of systems.

Whether you're playing solo or teaming up with friends, the possibilities are endless! Build massive rail systems, explore unique stations, and take on challenges that change every time you play. Infinite Rails is perfect for anyone who loves trains, creativity, and adventure.

🚂 Get ready to explore, build, and ride in a world of infinite possibilities!
